empty.body: New leads, team changes and automation alerts show up here as they happen.
empty.archivedBody: Notifications you archive are kept here.

alerts.title: New leads, outside the app
alerts.intro: Hear about a visitor while it still matters. These are only for new leads from your cards.
alerts.whatsappHint: A message on WhatsApp for each new lead, with a button to open it.
alerts.notReady: Not set up on this server yet. Ask whoever runs Vertex Connect to connect WhatsApp.
alerts.removed: Number removed. WhatsApp alerts are off.
alerts.badPhone: Enter the number with its country code, like +20 100 123 4567.
alerts.testSent: Test sent. It should arrive in a few seconds.
alerts.testFailed: WhatsApp didn't accept the message. Check the number and try again.
alerts.tooMany: Too many tests for now. Try again later.

prefs.intro: Choose what shows up here. Turning a type off stops new ones; the ones you have stay.
prefs.CRM: When someone shares their details from one of your cards.
prefs.ORGANIZATION: People joining or leaving, your role, teams and workspace settings.
prefs.SECURITY: Changes to your own access, like a suspension.
prefs.SYSTEM: Automation alerts and deliveries that failed.

types.automationFailedBody: Some of its actions failed on “{{event}}”.
types.memberAdded: You were added to the workspace
